agent_orientation.earlier_routes_exhausted_reason: REUSE was tried first and exhausted against a real artifact: verified_skill_crystallizer_v1.anti_unify_code_rule was read and refuses this job because it unifies token snippets and cannot express 'wrap these same holes at this AST position', and it carries no site context at all. obs_solution.efficiency_mechanism: Templates prune the space before execution: 224 candidates instead of 5,021 for the same held-out half.
obs_solution.generality_mechanism: Anti-unification with shared holes plus a node-type context precondition, so one demonstration yields a rule that fires wherever its precondition literally holds.
obs_solution.losing_routes_reason: The list edit is a hard zero on real fixes; the budget cannot reach an inexpressible edit; the token rule has no position or context; a model is prohibited producer cognition.

recursive_obs.why_selected_route_is_fastest_sufficient: Every cheaper route was tried against a real artifact and refused: the crystallizer's token anti-unification cannot express position-level containment and has no site context, and the existing repair primitive has no ast.AugAssign rule at all. Inducing a template from one demonstration pair and letting the corpus's own tests decide costs two runs; adding another hand-written mutation kind would lift one bug of forty and leave the question unmeasured.
recursive_obs.why_this_is_not_another_organ: It replaces a list with a fold over experience and reuses the existing repair primitive, the corpus oracle and the hashing/verification discipline; the only new machinery is induction and the rung classifier, and both are measured.
